# PCA's using Malagasy only data

First, choosing number of PC's (K) from scree plot of percentage variance explained.


```{r echo=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
#setwd("C:/Users/eviec/Git/malagasy_diversity")

dataM_LD <- pcadapt::read.pcadapt(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merged_malagasy_clean_auto_no_relatives_LDpruned.bed"), type = "bed") 

#Choose K value 
pca1LD <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = dataM_LD, K=10 , ploidy = 2)

plot(pca1LD, option = "screeplot") 

#Drops sharply after K=2

#Set to K=5
pca1LD <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = dataM_LD, K=3, ploidy = 2)


```
Sharp drop around 2, K is set to 3.


```{r echo=FALSE}

fam_Malagasy_LD <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merged_malagasy_clean_auto_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))
colnames(fam_Malagasy_LD) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")

#Rename Malagasy populations using population table
pop_table <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)
colnames(pop_table) <- c("IID", "V2","FID","Population","V5","V6","V7")
fam_Malagasy_LD$IID <- sub("RR.*", "", fam_Malagasy_LD$IID)

pop_table_sub <- subset(pop_table,pop_table$IID %in% fam_Malagasy_LD$IID & pop_table$V5 =="Madagascar")

matching_m <- match(fam_Malagasy_LD$IID, pop_table_sub$IID)
fam_Malagasy_LD$Population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_m), pop_table_sub$Population[matching_m], fam_Malagasy_LD$Popualtion)


#Find PC loadings
pca1LD$singular.values
#singular.values is a vector containing the K ordered square root of the proportion of variance explained by each PC.
variance.explained=(pca1LD$singular.values)^2 
variance.explained
sum(variance.explained)
PCA_scores_M <- as.data.frame(pca1LD$scores)

#PCA 1 & 2
ggplot(PCA_scores_M, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, colour = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, shape = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, fill = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = "PC 1 (0.02%)" , y = "PC 2 (0.01%)", colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))

```

```{r echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}

ggplot(PCA_scores_M, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, colour = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, shape = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, fill = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23))+
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = "PC 1 (0.02%)" , y = "PC 2 (0.01%)", colour = "Population", shape = "Population", fill = "Population") +
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))+

```


```{r echo=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
#PCA 1 & 2 black and white
ggplot(PCA_scores_M, aes(x = V1, y = V2, group = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population, shape = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population)) + #, fill = fam_Malagasy_LD$Population
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(1,3,7,15,17,19,21,23)) +
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = "PC 1 (0.02%)" , y = "PC 2 (0.01%)", shape = "Population") + #, fill = "Population"
  theme(legend.position = "right", legend.title = element_text(face="bold"))  
```


PCA of Malagasy populations alone shows overlap in PC space of the Betsimisaraka, Sakalava, Tsimhety, and Diego samples, all from Northern Madagascar. Some Merina samples also fall within this cluster, but the Merina and Betsileo (more Southern) populations show less overlap with others. However, the overall % explained by each PC is very low. 

```{r echo=FALSE}

MDS <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merged_malagasy_clean_auto_no_relatives_LDpruned_IBS_MDS.mds"), header=TRUE)
```

# PCA's of our merged data (so far)

```{r echo=FALSE}

data <- pcadapt::read.pcadapt(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_auto_1000G_V_no_relatives_LDpruned.bed"), type = "bed") 

#Choose K value
pca2 <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = data, K=10, ploidy = 2)
plot(pca2, option = "screeplot") 

#Drops after K=2 but levels off around K = 5 

#Set to K=5
pca2 <- pcadapt::pcadapt(input = data, K=5, ploidy = 2)

```

```{r echo=FALSE}
fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_auto_1000G_V_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))
colnames(fam) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")
G1000_groups <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/1000G_keep_all.txt"),sep = "\t")
colnames(G1000_groups) <- c("FID","IID", "Population", "Sex")

sub <- fam[fam$IID %in% G1000_groups$IID,] 

#Missing is individuals in the metadata G1000_groups who were filtered out in QC process
missing <- dplyr::anti_join(G1000_groups,sub,by = "IID")
G1000_groups <- dplyr::anti_join(G1000_groups,missing,by="IID")

#Match based on individual ID
matching_indices <- match(fam$IID, G1000_groups$IID)
#Replace FID column in fam with FID given in G1000_groups
fam$FID <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_indices), G1000_groups$FID[matching_indices], fam$FID)

#Population  labels
fam$Population <- NA
fam$Population <- ifelse(!is.na(matching_indices), G1000_groups$Population[matching_indices], fam$Population)

pop <- function(x){
  if(length(x) >= 7 && is.na(x[7])){
    x[7] <- x[1]
  }
  return(x)
}

fam <- apply(fam, FUN=pop, MARGIN = 1)
fam <- t(fam)
fam <- as.data.frame(fam)


#Rename Malagasy populations
pop_table <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/raw/data_input/Madagascar_Borneo.poptable"), sep = "\t", fill = TRUE)

fam$IID <- sub("RR.*", "", fam$IID)

fam[fam$IID %in% fam_Malagasy_LD$IID,] <- fam_Malagasy_LD

#Clean up the data
fam$Population <- sub(",.*", "", fam$Population)

Kinh <- fam[grepl("Kinh",fam$Population),]
Kinh$Population <- "Kinh Vietnamese"
fam[fam$FID=="KHV",] <- Kinh

SA <- fam[grepl("KHM_SA",fam$Population),]
SA$Population <- "Khomani San South Africa"
fam[fam$FID=="KHM_SA",] <- SA

BOR <- fam[grepl("BOR",fam$Population),]
BOR$Population <- "Borneo"
fam[fam$FID=="BOR",] <- BOR

fam$Population <- sapply(strsplit(fam$Population, "_"), function(x) paste(x, collapse = " and "))
 #to do after SA above

#Add a factor column so Malagasy can be a different shape/color
#Add Mikea, Temoro, and Vezo here 
fam$Malagasy <- 0
all_malagasy <- subset(fam, FID %in% c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland","Vez","Mik","Tem"))
fam[fam$IID %in% all_malagasy$IID, "Malagasy"] <- 1


pca2$singular.values
variance.explained=(pca2$singular.values)^2 
variance.explained
sum(variance.explained)

PCA_scores <- as.data.frame(pca2$scores)


main <- ggplot(PCA_scores, aes(x = V1, y= V2, colour = fam$Population, shape = as.factor(fam$Malagasy))) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + #alpha = fam$Malagasy
  labs(title = "Madagascar PCA", x = "PC 1 (0.11%)", y = "PC 2 (0.02%)", colour = "Population")+
  theme(legend.title = element_text(face="bold"), legend.position = "bottom")+
  guides(shape = "none") +
  geom_rect(aes(xmin = -0.02, xmax = 0.02, ymin = -0.02, ymax = 0.025), colour = "darkgrey",fill = NA, linetype = "dashed") 


zoom <- ggplot(PCA_scores, aes(x = V1, y= V2, colour = fam$Population, shape = as.factor(fam$Malagasy))) + geom_point(alpha = 0.5) + #alpha = fam$Malagasy
  #labs(x = "PC 1 (0.11%)", y = "PC 2 (0.02%)")+  
  theme(legend.position = "none", axis.title.x = element_blank(),axis.title.y = element_blank())+ #,axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  guides(shape = "none") + 
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.02,0.02),
             ylim = c(-0.02,0.025))



gridExtra::grid.arrange(main,zoom,ncol = 2)



```

In the first two PC's, the Malagasy form a cline between African and southeast Asian groups. The Merina are located closer to individuals from Borneo and the Lesser Sunda islands while Northern Malagasy groups are located towards Southern African and Bantu individuals.

```{r echo=FALSE}
#Sample indiviudals for a more balanced PCA

library(dplyr)
split_dfs <- fam %>% group_split(Population)

sampled_individuals <- list()

# Loop through each tibble in split_dfs
for(i in 1:length(split_dfs)) {
  # Sample 30 individuals from the current tibble if it has more than 30 rows, otherwise include all rows
  if (nrow(split_dfs[[i]]) > 30 ){
    sampled_individuals[[i]] <- split_dfs[[i]][sample(nrow(split_dfs[[i]]), size = 30), ]
  } else {
    sampled_individuals[[i]] <- split_dfs[[i]]
  }
}

new <- do.call(rbind,sampled_individuals)

original_fam <- read.table(resrepo::path_resrepo("/data/intermediate/biomart/merge_full_auto_1000G_V_no_relatives_LDpruned.fam"))
colnames(original_fam) <- c("FID", "IID", "V3","V4","V5","V6")

#Return Malagasy to RR
update <- new$FID %in% c("Central_Highland","East_Coast","Northern_Coast","NorthWestern_Coast","Southern_Highland")
new$IID[update] <- paste(new$IID[update], "RR", sep = "")



sub <- subset(original_fam, original_fam$IID %in% new$IID)


#Use this subset with --keep in plink 
write.table(sub[,c(1,2)], resrepo::path_resrepo("data/intermediate/biomart/sampled_individuals.txt"), row.names = FALSE, col.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE, sep="\t")



```
